_comment: Copy to pc-agent/config.json (the agent does this on first run) and edit. Restart the agent from the tray afterwards.
_voice_comment: voice_backend: auto | gemini | whisper. Source defaults: auto uses Gemini when gemini_api_key is set, otherwise local Whisper. This packaged build does not bundle Whisper, so without a Gemini key there is no working transcription. Gemini sends recorded audio to Google; GEMINI_API_KEY overrides the key below. gemini_model is a -latest alias so a retired model version cannot break it.
_calendar_comment: Read-only ICS links. Google Calendar: Settings > calendar > Secret address in iCal format. Leave empty to keep the Agenda face quiet.
_alerts_comment: Threshold banners. metric: cpu_pct, mem_pct, gpu_temp, gpu_util, gpu_power, disk_free_pct, disk_used_pct, net_down_mbps, net_up_mbps, proc_count. Service rules use host + port.
_briefing_comment: Optional morning/evening briefings pushed to connected Spots and the dashboard. Disabled by default; times are local wall-clock HH:MM. briefing_speak renders Piper audio after the banner. Context comes from the calendar feed and, when configured, Home Assistant states.
_wake_comment: Wake alarms ramp the screen from ambient to full brightness over this many minutes.
_media_comment: File in media/ that the Video Clock face loops. The Spot stores its own copy (long-press -> Video clip...).
_faces_comment: Optional server-side workers. Remove a face to stop its polling: clock, videoclock, pcmon, voice, assistant, comfy, timer, calendar, sky, markets, claude. An empty list runs everything.
_assistant_comment: Jarvis. hybrid uses Gemini first and falls back to a local Ollama-compatible /api/chat endpoint. The active local model is qwen3:14b; qwen2.5:7b-instruct stays available in the picker. assistant_speak writes WAVs to media/tts; assistant_stream_tts speaks each completed sentence while the rest streams. knowledge dirs are absolute paths; empty uses the agent's notes folder. apps/commands are fail-closed allowlists.
_tts_comment: Piper neural speech is bundled in piper/ and runs offline. tts_backend: auto uses Piper when installed, otherwise SAPI. tts_piper_model is a filename in piper/ (with its matching .onnx.json); length_scale under 1 is faster, over 1 slower. tts_style changes phrasing and the SAPI fallback voice; null tts_rate/tts_pitch/tts_volume use the style preset.
_memory_comment: search_notes uses keyword hits plus local Ollama embeddings (ollama pull nomic-embed-text); it falls back to keywords when embeddings are unavailable. half_life_days lowers the rank of old facts; compact_after summarises older conversation turns.
_tools_comment: assistant_tool_subset_size limits the tool declarations sent per turn (0 sends all). assistant_verify_complex adds one quiet review pass for complex answers. assistant_plugin_dir defaults to <agent>/plugins when blank. mcp_servers maps a name to {url, token, tools} for Model Context Protocol servers; their tools appear as mcp_<name>_<tool>. Leave {} to disable.
_devices_comment: Per-Spot preferences keyed by the UUID sent as ?device=<uuid> (or the dashboard's Device id). Example: {"spot-uuid": {"name": "Kitchen Spot", "model_choice": "local:qwen3:14b", "tts_style": "natural", "tts_length_scale": 0.95, "tts_voice": "", "tts_rate": 0, "tts_pitch": 0, "tts_volume": 100}}. Use local:qwen2.5:7b-instruct instead for a smaller device model. Supported keys: name, label, model_choice, tts_length_scale, tts_style, tts_voice, tts_rate, tts_pitch, tts_volume. A device's model_choice wins over the global assistant_model_choice; TTS fields override the global keys for that Spot. Leave {} until devices have been seen.
_routing_comment: Per-request backend choice. 'auto' keeps assistant_backend/assistant_model_choice. Vision needs a multimodal model: qwen2.5vl:7b for offline Ollama (ollama pull qwen2.5vl:7b) or Gemini with a key. A blank assistant_vision_model resolves to qwen2.5vl:7b for older installs. assistant_vision_backend 'auto' uses local Ollama when no Gemini key is configured; set 'local' to force offline. assistant_route_vision 'auto' keeps the chosen backend. If Gemini fails on an image turn, the local vision model answers instead.
_search_comment: Web tools. 'auto' prefers a configured JSON provider (SearXNG, Brave, Serper, Tavily) then falls back to DuckDuckGo HTML. API keys can also be set as BRAVE_API_KEY / SERPER_API_KEY / TAVILY_API_KEY environment variables. fetch_url blocks private hosts unless search_allow_private is true.
_home_assistant_comment: Optional smart-home control. call_service refuses any domain.service not on the allowlist.
_calendar_write_comment: Optional CalDAV write-back for calendar_add. Read-only ICS feeds remain the default source.
_robot_comment: MQTT transport for the robot vacuum tool. Set broker/topic/device_id once the device's topic and payload shape are known; otherwise the tool reports that it is not configured.
_api_comment: Empty here is a template value, not an unauthenticated mode. The installer generates a random per-install token when config.json is absent, and the agent generates one at startup if the field is empty (fail-closed if the config cannot be written). Enter the same value on the Spot: long-press -> PC hub token...
